reader.notes: Every use is enforced. Lead (diagnostic wording only, not a verdict): at --std 85 ReportEntryReferenceRefused quotes §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR10d (a format 3 rule) for EVERY non-sum-counter entry, so a reference to a format 2 name (s6.cob, MOVE TOT-GRP TO W-OUT) is told SR10d where SR7 governs, and a format 1 name would be told SR10d where SR5 governs; site src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/ReportSectionBinder.cs#ReportEntryReferenceRefused, the DialectLevel < 2002 arm.

refuter.evidence: Each other use of a format 2 name is refused. T1.cob (SUM TOT-GRP) gets COBOL2730. T2.cob (SOURCE LINE-COUNTER OF TOT-GRP, a qualifier of something other than a sum counter) gets COBOL2729. T3.cob (MOVE SRC OF TOT-GRP, where SRC is a SOURCE item) gets COBOL5092 citing SR10d. T4.cob (SUM ... RESET ON TOT-GRP) gets COBOL0899. The legal qualifier uses work. In T6.cob, SUM TOT-X OF TOT-GRP in CF FINAL rolls forward a CF W-K sum counter and prints 00012 / 00010 / 00022, which is correct. In T5.cob a Working-Storage TOT-X sits beside the sum counter, and TOT-X OF TOT-GRP resolves to the counter (MID=00012) while TOT-X OF WS-G gives 00007. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR7  (3.9.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR7'.
